evidence: Tagged with the 'Private Broadcast' label and modifies src/private_broadcast.{cpp,h} and src/net_processing.cpp to change how finished transactions are tracked.
rationale: Retains finished and echoed private broadcast transactions in memory instead of dropping them, improving operator visibility into broadcast history and network echo times. The PR description notes that for finished transactions this allows inspection of 'when and to whom the transaction was sent as well as when/if it was echoed from the network', which is a worthwhile diagnostic improvement with no release urgency.
